answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 28331 Country: India Title: I am working for someone who gives me transportation exp.of first class in the train, but for the sake of saving i always travels in the second class, so the saved money from first class to second class, can i use for my personal use, 2. my money was stolen then can i use interest money instead of such stolen money Question: sir, i am working for someone who gives me transportation exp.of first class in the train, but for the sake of saving i always travels in the second class, so the saved money from first class to second class, can i use for my personal use, 2. my money was stolen then can i use interest money instead of such stolen money Answer ID: 28331 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 48/48/M=1432) (1) It is not right to travel in second class to save money when you get the expenses of first class. It is against religion. And if you have to tell a lie, it is more contemptible. Yes, if you talk your owner in clear-cut words and he gives the expenses in your possession and gives you option to spend it as you wish, then it is allowed. (2) If you turned poor and destitute after your money was stolen, you can use the interest money. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
